basics.name: Jane Doe
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 10+ years across a large delivery marketplace, a major cloud provider, and a global e-commerce company. Built the prototype that became a flagship conversational shopping agent and carried it through launch; now operates at platform scope, owning the tool layer that internal domain agents and external integrations build on, with AI coding tools in the daily workflow.

work.name: Company A
highlights: Built the prototype that became the company's conversational shopping assistant, launched Jun 2026: builds carts from recipe links, cookbook photos, and photographed shopping lists across roughly 800,000 products, personalized from order history and dietary preferences; the feature raised average order totals.

Set the agent-platform direction: wrote the strategy and campaigned it through leadership, moving the company from third-party agent-protocol ordering—its first external agent integration—to a first-party in-app assistant.

Own platform and reliability for the multi-agent assistant: the grocery domain agent plus the shared tool layer that also powers the restaurant agent, the third-party chat-app integration, and the company's new developer CLI.

Built the retail division's integration-test framework and moved test execution from Jenkins to Buildkite on Kubernetes; golden-path ordering tests now run against segregated test tenants as blocking CI gates.
Mentor engineers across the org on agent architecture and tool design, and drive team adoption of AI-assisted development—with architecture and security review before merge.

work.name: Company B
highlights: Built and launched an industrial IoT monitoring control plane (Go, DynamoDB, API Gateway), announced at the company's flagship conference; drove it through operational readiness review to GA.

Led a console migration from Angular to React on a microfrontend architecture with infrastructure-as-code pipelines, letting 5+ sub-teams ship independently and cutting release lead time from weeks to days.
Designed SSO federation for the monitoring product and built synthetic canaries that caught console regressions before release.

work.name: Company C
highlights: Built a secure platform (Ruby on Rails, Java Spring) for anti-money-laundering and identity-theft investigations, with end-to-end encryption, granular access controls, and audit logging.
Built regulatory transaction-reporting systems for two European financial intelligence units, meeting the requirements for the company's payments business in those markets.

work.name: Company D
highlights: Integrated a subscription book catalog into a social reading platform.

work.name: Company E
highlights: Tested handheld device software (smoke, regression, GUI).

projects.name: Multi-Agent Platform
highlights: Run Python agents in production behind a FastAPI gateway, with Next.js web and Expo mobile clients sharing state over a streaming UI protocol.
Protocol-backed tools for groceries, fitness, travel, trends, and public resume Q&A; the grocery tool started as the shopping-assistant prototype.

publications.name: Designing Tools for Agents
publications.summary: What makes a tool easy for an LLM agent to call correctly.
